name: nonApi_setRunsPageState
description: The runs-page importer's bookkeeping for one kennel (E3.F6.S3, 2026-10-04): stamps RunsPageCheckedAt = now on every call; stores the page fingerprint (@hash) when given (the API sends it only after a successful import, so a failed read is retried next time); stamps RunsPageChangedAt when @changed = 1; replaces RunsPageStatus (one line for the portal, cut to 500) when @status is given. NULL keeps a column as it is. These columns are treated as bookkeeping by trgUpdateModifiedOnDateForKennels: no updatedAt stamp, so no phone re-syncs the kennel four times a day. Called by the API only (RunsPageImport); no auth. An unknown or NULL @kennelId is a silent no-op. Returns nothing; a runtime error is logged to HC.ErrorLog and re-thrown.

parameters.name: kennelId
parameters.description: The kennel whose runs page was checked. NULL ⇒ no-op. Default NULL.

parameters.name: hash
parameters.description: SHA-256 hex fingerprint of the page as imported; NULL = keep the stored one. Matches the column (CHAR(64)). Default NULL.

parameters.name: changed
parameters.description: 1 = the page changed and was read by the model ⇒ RunsPageChangedAt = now. Default 0.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: One line for the portal ('12 runs, 2 new'); cut to 500. NULL = keep. Default NULL.
parameters.typeMismatch: Parameter NVARCHAR(MAX) vs column NVARCHAR(500) — trimmed with LEFT(…, 500).

sideEffects: UPDATE HC.Kennel SET RunsPageCheckedAt = SYSUTCDATETIME(), RunsPageHash, RunsPageChangedAt, RunsPageStatus WHERE id = @kennelId. updatedAt is NOT stamped (the Kennel trigger excludes these columns).
On any runtime error: rolls back if a transaction is open, inserts one HC.ErrorLog row (HcVersion '<api>'), then THROWs.
breakingChangeRules: Never remove a column from any rowset
Never change a sentinel value meaning
Never change errorType integer codes without updating all callers
